what_happened.line: The superintendent presented the proposed FY21 school budget, including three priority positions, and the committee voted to accept the presentation.
Members debated how to balance support between the lower grades and the high school during the budget discussion.
The proposed increase combines level service staff costs, new positions and a new salary reserve, offset by expense reductions.
The committee approved the Seal of Biliteracy; the minutes record the vote as not audible.
The committee gave third reading to the fiscal policies and named a representative to the paraprofessional and custodial negotiation teams.

why_it_matters: The FY21 school budget feeds into the town's overall spending and tax picture, and a public commenter pointed to a town five-year forecast showing a shortfall.
The budget assumes state aid (Chapter 70) will not rise much, so a change in state or federal aid would affect what the district can fund.
